'''Kebolar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was used for the removal of colonists from [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] had already established farms for the colonists.

==Appearances==
*''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'' {{1stm}}
